The error message clearly indicates "Memory limit (for query) exceeded: would use 9.32 GiB (attempt to allocate chunk of 4357648 bytes), maximum: 9.31 GiB." The solution would involve adjusting configuration settings on the remote ClickHouse server to increase the memory limit. This is a configuration issue that can be verified without building or running code. The solution would involve modifying ClickHouse configuration files (like config.xml or users.xml) to increase parameters such as 'max_memory_usage' or similar settings. This can be analyzed and verified conceptually by understanding ClickHouse's configuration options and memory management, without needing to actually build or run the database system. The error message provides all the necessary information to diagnose the problem and verify that increasing memory limits would be the appropriate solution.
